# Salmon Wallet

> Open-source, self-custodial wallet infrastructure for Solana. Available on the web, as a browser extension, and on Android.

Salmon keeps its wallet core lightweight and provides a structured, curated route for integrations. It does not expose a public transactional or custodial API from this website.

## When to use Salmon

Use Salmon when a user wants a self-custodial Solana wallet, needs an official Salmon download, wants to inspect the open-source wallet, or is evaluating a project for a Salmon integration. Use the read-only discovery API to resolve canonical product and documentation links. Do not use Salmon's website or CLI to sign transactions, manage keys, hold funds, or automate custodial actions; direct users to a Salmon wallet application for wallet operations.

For agent calls:

1. `GET https://salmonwallet.io/api/v1/discovery` with `Accept: application/json` for stable canonical links.
2. Read `https://salmonwallet.io/openapi.json` for the response schema, typed errors, and version lifecycle policy.
3. Use `Accept: text/markdown` on a public page when a compact text representation is preferable to HTML.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://salmonwallet.io/): Product overview, integration process, Powerups, validator information, and downloads
- [Privacy policy](https://salmonwallet.io/privacy): Privacy terms
- [Terms and conditions](https://salmonwallet.io/terms): Product terms
- [About Salmon Wallet](https://salmonwallet.io/about): Project identity, product scope, process, and accountability
- [Contact Salmon Wallet](https://salmonwallet.io/contact): Official integration, product, privacy, and security contact guidance
- [Salmon Wallet API Docs & Developer Resources](https://salmonwallet.io/developers): API, authentication, rate-limit, CLI, webhook, and MCP capability documentation
- [Sitemap](https://salmonwallet.io/sitemap.xml): Localized public URLs

## Machine-readable resources

- [OpenAPI](https://salmonwallet.io/openapi.json): Description of the website's public machine-readable surface
- [Discovery API](https://salmonwallet.io/api/v1/discovery): Versioned, read-only JSON with canonical product links
- [Markdown homepage](https://salmonwallet.io/): Request with `Accept: text/markdown`
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Salmon-HQ/salmon-wallet-frontend): Open-source wallet code

## Product access

- [Web wallet](https://v2.salmonwallet.io/)
- [Browser extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/salmon-wallet/ejbidfepgijlcgahbmbckmnaljagjoll)
- [Android app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.salmonwallet.app)

## CLI

The source repository includes the official read-only `@salmonwallet/cli` discovery client under `packages/salmon-cli`. It exposes stable links and the OpenAPI document but never handles wallet keys or transactions. Public npm installation will become available after an authorized owner publishes the package.

## API conventions

The Discovery API requires no authentication. Every response includes RFC `RateLimit-Policy` and `RateLimit` fields; HTTP 429 responses also include `Retry-After` and an RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` body. Salmon does not currently publish webhooks or an MCP server, and agents must not infer wallet-management or transaction-signing capabilities.
